name: Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF) 2026
location: Taman Baca Ubud
description: Southeast Asia’s biggest literary event, Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF), returns this 22 to 25 October with a powerful programme of over a hundred separate events. For its 23rd year, authors, thinkers, journalists, poets and more will descend upon Ubud for a week of insight and intrigue. The theme this year is ‘Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.’, which will guide UWRF’s main programme’s many curated conversations and panels. 150 of the region’s most current, exciting writers will discuss the transformative power of storytelling and its ability to mobilise and enlighten individuals, communities and humanity. As always, the UWRF festival carefully selects its Main Programme speakers, whose works, knowledge and life experiences add poignance, depth and reality into each year’s discussions. A highly-anticipated speaker is Tari Lang , author of the memoir ‘ My Neighbour, The Dictator,’ in which she recounts her life as a fourteen-year-old girl in 1965 when General Suharto’s coup saw her parents imprisoned without trial, and how this history continues to shape who she is.
